span.p: spec §1 — the closed effect vocabulary + Unknown (the §4 trust marker, not an effect). Declared in spec-name order.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: SEMANTICS §1 — a lattice element (join = ∪). toNames() emits spec-name-sorted: the ONE wire path, and the byte-identity invariant.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: spec §2 — the per-unit entry ('effector' = the spec's 'unit'). The wire field stays fn; serialized by ReportJson, not by reflecting the record (conditional omission).

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: spec §4 — a kind:detail disclosure tag. Stores the raw prefix so any (incl. foreign) tag round-trips; kind() is derived.

span.p: spec §4 canonical: reflect/native/dispatch/callback. task-handoff/indy are candor-java extras (tracked follow-up).
